name: Try Again
summary: A retry button that spins, backs off with a countdown when offline and turns into a check when it works
about: A photo backup card with three photos that could not upload. Try again winds its arrow back, shrinks the pill to a spinning circle and draws a searching ring; while offline the ring turns red, the button shakes and counts down to an automatic retry that waits longer each time. With Wi-Fi on, the photos fly up into the cloud one by one, the ring closes, the circle turns mint, the arrow becomes a check and confetti pops.
how: Press Try again (or Tab to it and press Enter) to retry the upload.
While Wi-Fi is off, watch it fail and count down to the next try; press during the countdown to retry now.
Turn the Wi-Fi switch on to simulate getting back online; a waiting retry starts at once.
After the backup, press Lose the connection again to reset the card.
